entry.name: 分诊台
entry.author: jjjjjjjjnnjnn
entry.description: 装前判断与装后归因：一条命令说明插件为什么从你的组合里消失（被 admission 拒绝的行 / 模块导入失败 / 声明了但没注册上的能力），在隔离的 DSH_HOME 里真装真启动并落证据，只读展示当前组合。不安装、不卸载、不判安全。
entry.descriptionEn: Pre-install judgement and post-mortem attribution: one command says why a plugin disappeared from your profile (rows denied by admission, modules that failed to import, capabilities declared but never registered), measures a candidate inside an isolated DSH_HOME with recorded evidence, and shows the current composition read-only. It never installs, never removes, and never claims a plugin is safe.
